name: netconnect
description: Plateforme de souscription aux forfaits Internet (React + Express + Prisma/PostgreSQL) — paiements simulés

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait db
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
